items.title: Universal catenarity of a locally Noetherian scheme is local, and passes to schemes locally of finite type over it
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four equivalent locality conditions for universal catenarity of a locally Noetherian scheme and adds that schemes locally of finite type over it stay universally catenary (statement lines 3335-3349). The counted proof organises the cycle of implications: it gets the final assertion and the implication from (1) to (2) from stability of local finiteness of type under open immersions and composites, converts an affine universally catenary chart into universal catenarity of its coordinate ring via the algebra lemma on finite type algebras, notes the trivial implication from (3) to (4), and closes the argument for (4) implies (1) by covering a locally finite type morphism by affine charts and invoking locality of catenarity (proof lines 3351-3377). It is H2: the proof is a well-organised reduction carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard stability and locality statements.
